description.en: Circuit diagram of a full-wave rectifier using a center-tapped transformer and two diodes.
description.hi: सेंटर-टैप्ड ट्रांसफार्मर और दो डायोड का उपयोग करने वाले पूर्ण-तरंग दिष्टकारी का परिपथ आरेख।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 350" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(50, 50)">
    <!-- AC Input Symbol -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="100" r="20" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M -12 100 Q -6 85 0 100 T 12 100" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="-25" y="140" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">AC Input</text>

    <!-- Primary Coil -->
    <line x1="20" y1="100" x2="60" y2="100" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M 60 100 C 60 50, 80 50, 80 100 C 80 150, 100 150, 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(90, 80, 100) translate(0, -20)" />
    <!-- Manual drawing of inductor coil for primary -->
    <path d="M 60 40 Q 75 40 75 60 Q 75 80 60 80 Q 75 80 75 100 Q 75 120 60 120 Q 75 120 75 140 Q 75 160 60 160" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <line x1="20" y1="40" x2="60" y2="40" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="20" y1="160" x2="60" y2="160" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="20" y1="40" x2="20" y2="80" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="20" y1="120" x2="20" y2="160" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Core -->
    <line x1="90" y1="30" x2="90" y2="170" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="98" y1="30" x2="98" y2="170" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="3" />

    <!-- Secondary Coil -->
    <path d="M 130 40 Q 115 40 115 60 Q 115 80 130 80 Q 115 80 115 100 Q 115 120 130 120 Q 115 120 115 140 Q 115 160 130 160" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="135" y="35" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">A</text>
    <text x="135" y="175" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">B</text>

    <!-- Diode D1 -->
    <line x1="130" y1="40" x2="180" y2="40" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <polygon points="180,25 180,55 210,40" fill="#111827" />
    <line x1="210" y1="25" x2="210" y2="55" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="185" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">D1</text>

    <!-- Diode D2 -->
    <line x1="130" y1="160" x2="180" y2="160" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <polygon points="180,145 180,175 210,160" fill="#111827" />
    <line x1="210" y1="145" x2="210" y2="175" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="185" y="190" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">D2</text>

    <!-- Connecting N sides -->
    <line x1="210" y1="40" x2="260" y2="40" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="210" y1="160" x2="260" y2="160" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="260" y1="40" x2="260" y2="160" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Center Tap & Load Resistor -->
    <line x1="130" y1="100" x2="320" y2="100" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="130" cy="100" r="3" fill="#111827" />
    <line x1="260" y1="100" x2="260" y2="75" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Resistor zigzag -->
    <polyline points="260,75 250,70 270,60 250,50 260,45 260,40" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="280" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">RL</text>

    <!-- Output -->
    <circle cx="260" cy="100" r="3" fill="#111827" />
    <line x1="260" y1="40" x2="340" y2="40" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="340" cy="40" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="340" cy="100" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="320" y1="100" x2="340" y2="100" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <text x="355" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">DC Output</text>
    <!-- Output waveform small sketch -->
    <path d="M 360 40 Q 370 25 380 40 Q 390 25 400 40" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="355" y1="40" x2="410" y2="40" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1" />
  </g>
</svg>
